title: Image Generation Request
description: Request body for the POST /api/generate/image endpoint.

prompt.description: Positive text prompt describing the desired image. Use cinematic language for best results.

negative_prompt.description: Things to avoid in the generated image.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible generation. Null = random.

style.description: Visual style preset applied to the prompt.

shot_index.description: Optional shot index within the scene.

backend_preference.description: Preferred image generation backend. Falls back to priority list if unavailable.

callback_url.description: URL to POST the result to when generation completes (for async mode).

output_path.description: Override the default output file path.

examples.prompt: A medieval castle at sunset, dramatic cinematic lighting, epic wide angle shot, volumetric fog, 4K detail, masterpiece quality
examples.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, deformed, ugly, bad anatomy
